correctness.rationale: Read RESULT.md full proof and independently reconstructed DQ=BD with D=[[-1,1,0],[0,-1,1]], B=[[-(a+b),c],[b,-(c+d)]]. D is onto, positive 2x2 Metzler semigroup has exact weighted l1 norm equal its largest positive column sum. u,v are positive distinct roots of lambda^2-(alpha+beta)lambda+alpha beta-bc; g_j solves second-order scalar ODE with g_j(0)=1, derivative delta_j. Delta1 and delta2 cannot both positive because (a+b)(c+d)>bc. Each positive-slope profile has one maximum and a unique subsequent crossing of 1; negative/zero slope profiles strictly decrease for positive time. Unit rates w=(1,3) yield 2e^-t-e^-3t and q=e^-T=(sqrt5-1)/2. Reconstructed steps attain columns. Independently checked 200 direct exp(tQ) matrix norms for randomized positive rates/weights against formulas with maximum absolute difference 3.15e-14. No inference of general proof from these finite checks.
